binaries.name: fls
binaries.why: List files, deleted entries and named streams in an image. Invoked as an executable: CPL and IPL cannot be combined with AGPL in one work.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: icat
binaries.why: Extract a file by inode, including a named stream. Invoked as an executable: CPL and IPL cannot be combined with AGPL in one work.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: istat
binaries.why: Confirm an inode's size, timestamps and allocation before trusting an extract. Invoked as an executable: CPL and IPL cannot be combined with AGPL in one work.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: fsstat
binaries.why: Volume serial, cluster size and file system type. Invoked as an executable: CPL and IPL cannot be combined with AGPL in one work.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: mmls
binaries.why: Partition table, and the sector offset every other command needs. Invoked as an executable: CPL and IPL cannot be combined with AGPL in one work.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: ewfinfo
binaries.why: Read an E01's acquisition record and its stored digests.

binaries.name: tsk_recover
binaries.why: Bulk recovery of deleted files from an image. Invoked as an executable.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: img_stat
binaries.why: The size and format of an image as The Sleuth Kit reads it, E01 included: the bound for a scan over the whole of it.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: img_cat
binaries.why: The raw bytes of an image, E01 included, over a range of sectors: a signature scan without converting the image first.
binaries.licence: CPL-1.0 core, IPL-1.0 in the TCT-derived parts

binaries.name: bdeinfo
binaries.why: Read a BitLocker volume header: encryption method and every key protector, before any key is known.

binaries.name: dislocker
binaries.why: Unlock a BitLocker volume to a file once a key or a clear-key protector is in hand. Invoked as an executable.

binaries.name: cryptsetup
binaries.why: Read a LUKS header and its key slots, and open the volume when a key is known.

binaries.name: qemu-img
binaries.why: Convert a VHD, VHDX, VMDK or QCOW2 disk to raw, which is what the toolkit reads.

binaries.name: log2timeline
binaries.why: Build a super timeline from a whole image in one pass: every parser Plaso carries, into one storage file. Older packages install it as log2timeline.py; the tool accepts either.

binaries.name: psort
binaries.why: Filter, sort and export a Plaso storage file. The half of a super timeline an examiner actually reads. Older packages install it as psort.py; the tool accepts either.

binaries.name: bulk_extractor
binaries.why: Sweep a whole image for features at scale: addresses, URLs, card numbers, EXIF, and carved records, without a file system.

install.apt: built from source 2.2.0 (install.build): not packaged for Debian 12

binaries.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later for the code since 2015; the original NPS work is public domain; bundled third-party code keeps its own (unrar's among them)

binaries.name: photorec
binaries.why: Signature recovery over unallocated space, and a partition table a damaged disk no longer has.

binaries.name: target-query
binaries.why: One query interface over E01, VMDK, QCOW and a triage collection, with a plugin per artefact family. AGPL-3.0, the same licence as this harness.

binaries.name: luksdeinfo
binaries.why: Read a LUKS header and its key slots without unlocking the volume.

binaries.name: fvdeinfo
binaries.why: Read a FileVault volume's encryption metadata and its key material references.

binaries.name: fsapfsinfo
binaries.why: Read an APFS container and its volumes, which the Sleuth Kit does not. Experimental libfsapfs: upstream does not support snapshots, Fusion drives or T2 encryption.

binaries.name: pdftotext
binaries.why: The text of a PDF (-layout keeps its columns); pdfinfo, pdfimages and pdftohtml come in the same package.

binaries.name: ccl_indexeddb_dump
binaries.why: A Chromium or Electron IndexedDB (a chat client's, a web app's) read by database, object store and record; the ccl_chromium_reader library beside it, in /opt/dfir/src/ccl_indexeddb_dump/.venv/bin/python, also reads LevelDB, Local Storage, Session Storage and the cache.
